items.verification: File page attribution, licence and Flickr review inspected. Actual image inspected: loose optical elements, holders, lamp and screens on a table. Caption deliberately does not describe an assembled bench. Source-identity search found no earlier P101 reuse.

mediaDecision: Two task-specific setup diagrams plus a real instrument-kit context image support the independent assessment. Assessed wave profiles and ray constructions remain student work. An answer-generating simulation or explanatory video would change the independence of the task; neither added. No arbitrary image quota or reduction in teaching standard.
accessibility: Captions and textual setup specify required information; SVG title/description and photograph alt text. Keyboard-scrollable diagrams/table, explicit narrow-screen scroll cue, semantic MathML, no motion, offline embedded photograph.
